# plover v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

Plover provides a high-level API for connecting to IMAP servers over implicit TLS, authenticating, managing mailboxes, and fetching/searching/storing messages.

## Pages

- Guides
  - [Email Content](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/email-content.md)
  - [Testing with Plover](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/testing.md)
  - [Unsolicited Responses](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/unsolicited-responses.md)

## Modules

- [Plover](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.md): IMAP4rev2 client library for Elixir.
- [Plover.Auth.Plain](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Auth.Plain.md): SASL PLAIN authentication encoder.
- [Plover.Auth.XOAuth2](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Auth.XOAuth2.md): Google XOAUTH2 authentication encoder.
- [Plover.BodyStructure](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.BodyStructure.md): Traversal utilities for `%Plover.Response.BodyStructure{}` trees.
- [Plover.Command](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Command.md): Represents an IMAP command to be sent to the server.
- [Plover.Connection](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Connection.md): GenServer managing a single IMAP connection.
- [Plover.Content](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Content.md): Content-Transfer-Encoding decoding and charset conversion for email body parts.
- [Plover.Protocol.CommandBuilder](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Protocol.CommandBuilder.md): Serializes `%Command{}` structs to iodata for transmission over the wire.
- [Plover.Protocol.Parser](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Protocol.Parser.md): Recursive-descent parser for IMAP response token lists.
- [Plover.Protocol.ResponseEncoder](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Protocol.ResponseEncoder.md): Serializes response structs to IMAP wire-format strings.
- [Plover.Protocol.Tokenizer](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Protocol.Tokenizer.md): Tokenizes IMAP response lines from binary data into a token stream.
- [Plover.Response](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.md): Top-level module for IMAP response types.
- [Plover.Response.Address](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Address.md): An email address structure.
- [Plover.Response.BodyStructure](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.BodyStructure.md): The body structure of a message.
- [Plover.Response.Capability](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Capability.md): CAPABILITY response data.
- [Plover.Response.Condition](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Condition.md): An untagged status response (OK, NO, BAD, BYE, or PREAUTH).
- [Plover.Response.Continuation](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Continuation.md): A continuation request response.
- [Plover.Response.ESearch](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.ESearch.md): ESEARCH response data.
- [Plover.Response.Enabled](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Enabled.md): ENABLED response data.
- [Plover.Response.Envelope](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Envelope.md): The envelope structure of a message.
- [Plover.Response.Mailbox](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Mailbox.md): Mailbox-related response structures.

- [Plover.Response.Mailbox.Exists](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Mailbox.Exists.md): An EXISTS response indicating the number of messages in the mailbox.
- [Plover.Response.Mailbox.Flags](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Mailbox.Flags.md): A FLAGS response.
- [Plover.Response.Mailbox.List](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Mailbox.List.md): A LIST response entry.
- [Plover.Response.Mailbox.Status](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Mailbox.Status.md): A STATUS response.
- [Plover.Response.Message](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Message.md): Message-related response structures.

- [Plover.Response.Message.Expunge](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Message.Expunge.md): An EXPUNGE response.
- [Plover.Response.Message.Fetch](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Message.Fetch.md): A FETCH response for a single message.
- [Plover.Response.Tagged](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Tagged.md): A tagged server response (OK/NO/BAD).
- [Plover.Response.Unhandled](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Response.Unhandled.md): An unrecognized untagged response.
- [Plover.SequenceSet](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.SequenceSet.md): Parse and format IMAP sequence sets.
- [Plover.Transport](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Transport.md): Behaviour for IMAP transport connections.
- [Plover.Transport.Mock](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Transport.Mock.md): Mock transport for testing. Each mock socket is a GenServer process
that stores enqueued responses and records sent data.
- [Plover.Transport.SSL](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Transport.SSL.md): SSL transport implementation for production IMAP connections.

- [Plover.Types](https://plover.hexdocs.pm/Plover.Types.md): Shared type definitions for the Plover IMAP client.
